title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/HOOD LATCH (125,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  POLICE AND TAXI VEHICLES.     THE HOOD LATCH STRIKER CAN WEAR OR BECOME DETACHED FROM THE HOOD.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/HANDRAILS (24,082 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH OUTWARD OPENING SERVICE DOORS.  THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS FOR AN ITEM WORN BY A CHILD, SUCH AS A LONG DRAWSTRING, SASH, OR BACKPACK/BOOKBAG ACCESSORY, CAN BECOME CAUGHT IN A SMALL OPENING AT THE FLOOR LEVEL OF THE FORWARD DOOR POST.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: PREVOST/PART 565, VIN LABEL (170 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (VIN) IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH PART 565, "VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER - CONTENT REQUIREMENTS."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES-BENZ/FRONT BRAKE HOSES (27,000 affected)
summary: IF THE FRONT WHEELS ARE TURNED TO FULL LOCK, THE WHEEL COULD CONTACT THE BRAKE HOSE AND DAMAGE THE HOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SEAT RECLINER MECHANISM (624,433 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  EXTENDED CAB AND 2-DOOR UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH RECLINING SEATS AND THE EASY-ENTRY FEATURE.   THESE VEHICLES EXHIBIT A CONDITION IN WHICH A PINCH POINT EXISTS IN THE RECLINER MECHANISM THAT CAN TRAP AND PINCH A PERSON'S HAND OR FINGER(S) WHEN THE EASY-ENTRY FEATURE IS ACTIVATED.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/ALTERNATOR (118,485 affected)
summary: AN INTEGRATED CIRCUIT WITHIN THE VOLTAGE REGULATOR CAN CONTAIN MANUFACTURING ERRORS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 210 (20,959 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH CENTER REAR SEAT BELT ANCHOR BOLTS NOT PROPERLY INSTALLED.  THIS DOES  NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: PEUGEOT, INC.: PEUGEOT/HEADLIGHT LENS (10,816 affected)
summary: A GRADUAL DETERIORATION OF THE HEADLIGHT PLASTIC LENS OCCURS.

title: GUARDIAN PERSONAL SECURITY: GUARDIAN/PEPPER SPRAY (25,670 affected)
summary: THE AEROSOL CAN CORRODES ALLOWING THE FLAMMABLE CONTENTS TO ESCAPE.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/FRONT AXLE HUB (270 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT A LOCK WASHER AND/OR SCREWS IN THE FRONT HUB.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/ACURA/FRONT AXLE HUB (123 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT A LOCK WASHER AND/OR SCREWS IN THE FRONT HUB.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/WIRING HARNESS (70,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH MEMORY SEAT OPTION.    THE MEMORY SEAT MODULE WIRING HARNESS CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE SEAT SPRING,  A LOW RESISTANCE SHORT CIRCUIT CAN DEVELOP RESULTING IN LOCALIZED HEATING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FMVSS 210 (77,000 affected)
summary: THE WEB MOUNTED REAR SEAT BELT INBOARD ANCHOR POSITIONS MAY NOT ACHIEVE THE REQUIRED LOAD OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/ELECTRIC CARS/SHORT CIRCUIT (264 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  ELECTRIC VEHICLES.        THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH A DRIVE MOTOR CHARGER RECEPTACLE ASSEMBLY THAT WAS INCOMPLETELY SEALED.  INCOMPLETE SEALING CAN ALLOW WATER TO INTRUDE INTO THE CIRCUIT BOARD.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: TOYOTA/AIR BAG (61,202 affected)
summary: IF THE AIR BAG COMPUTER IN A SUBJECT VEHICLE EXPERIENCES A  MECHANICAL SHOCK (I.E., RAPIDLY MOVING THE FRONT SEAT BACK AGAINST THE STOPS OR A SUDDEN RELEASE OF THE PARKING BRAKE) WITHIN A VERY SHORT TIME AFTER THE ENGINE IS STARTED, THE AIR BAG CAN DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AIR BAG (17,094 affected)
summary: IF THE AIR BAG COMPUTER IN A SUBJECT VEHICLE EXPERIENCES A  MECHANICAL SHOCK (I.E., RAPIDLY  MOVING THE FRONT SEAT BACK AGAINST THE STOPS OR A SUDDEN RELEASE OF THE PARKING BRAKE) WITHIN A VERY SHORT TIME AFTER THE ENGINE IS STARTED, THE AIR BAG CAN DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/TIE ROD ASSEMBLY (1,414 affected)
summary: THE REAR SUSPENSION TIE ROD ASSEMBLY CAN FRACTURE.

title: Jaguar Cars, Ltd.: JAGUAR/REAR SUSPENSION (2,303 affected)
summary: THE DIFFERENTIAL OUTPUT SHAFT RETAINING RINGS ON THE REAR SUSPENSION CAN BECOME DISPLACED ALLOWING THE OUTPUT SHAFT TO BECOME DETACHED FROM THE DIFFERENTIAL UNIT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 101 (3 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH FD1060 AND FD1460 DIESEL ENGINES AND OPTIONAL MANUAL FUEL SHUTOFF SYSTEMS.  THE HAND CONTROL OF THE MANUAL FUEL SHUTOFF SYSTEM, MOUNTED ON THE VEHICLE'S INSTRUMENT PANEL, IS LABELED WITH THE WORDS "SHUTOFF FUEL LOCK", AND THESE WORDS ARE NOT ILLUMINATED OTHER THAN BY THE CAB'S INTERIOR LIGHTS.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 101, "CONTROLS AND DISPLAYS."

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SAAB/THROTTLE CONTROL (52,500 affected)
summary: CORROSION AROUND THE ZINC-COATED THROTTLE CONTROL LEVER BUSHING CAN CAUSE THE THROTTLE LEVER TO BIND.

title: Marmon-Herrington: MARMON-HERRINGTON/AXLE (144 affected)
summary: THE AXLE HUB WHEEL STUDS CAN FRACTURE.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/SEAT BELT RETRACTORS (67 affected)
summary: AN ADHESIVE USED IN THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR CAN CAUSE THE MOUNTING TO WEAKEN.

title: COSCO, INC.: COSCO/INFANT CHILD SEAT (34,580 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ARRIVA INFANT SEAT, MODEL NUMBER 02-751, MANUFACTURED FROM MARCH 1, 1995 THROUGH MAY 31, 1995. SEPARATION OF THE BUCKLE LATCH RELEASE BUTTON AND SPRING FROM THE LATCH RELEASE HOUSING ASSEMBLY.

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: ROLLS-ROYCE/AIR BAG (10 affected)
summary: THE ALUMINUM FACIA TRIM PANEL ON THE PASSENGER SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM (SRS) AIR BAG DOOR CAN DETACH DURING AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT.

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: ROLLS-ROYCE/HYDRAULIC HOSES (38 affected)
summary: TWO HYDRAULIC SYSTEM PIPES CONNECTING THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE PUMPS TO THE ACCUMULATORS CAN CONTACT EACH OTHER, RESULTING IN A HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK.

title: SAGEM INC.: SAGEM/AFTERMARKET GAS INJECTOR (32,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET GASOLINE FUEL INJECTORS DATE-CODED 0357 THROUGH 0597.  A CRACK IN THE STEEL ALLOWS FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE INJECTOR VIA THE CRIMP HOLES.

title: IC CORPORATION: NAVISTAR (AMTRAN)/POWER STEERING (1,473 affected)
summary: THE LOW PRESSURE POWER STEERING RETURN HOSE CAN EITHER BURST OR BECOME DISCONNECTED DUE TO INCREASED FLUID VISCOSITY IN FRIGID TEMPERATURES.
